info.title: memex
info.description: Command-line interface for MeshWeaver / Memex — operates the mesh over the REST API (get, upload, patch, compile, mirror, …).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: memex — CLI for MeshWeaver / Memex over the portal REST API.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Portal base URL (default: $MEMEX_BASE_URL, ~/.memex/config.json, or https://memex.meshweaver.cloud)

options.name: --token
options.description: API token mw_… (default: $MEMEX_TOKEN or ~/.memex/config.json)

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read a node or resource by path.

options.name: --base-path
options.description: Restrict search to a subtree

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a node from a JSON file (single MeshNode object).

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to JSON file containing the node body.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update nodes from a JSON array file (full-replace).

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to JSON file containing an array of MeshNode objects.

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Partial update of a node's top-level fields.

options.name: --fields
options.description: Inline JSON object of fields to set.

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to JSON file (alternative to --fields).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Mesh path of the node to patch.

arguments.name: PATHS
arguments.description: One or more mesh paths to delete (recursive).

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move a node and its descendants.

commands.name: copy
commands.description: Copy a node and its descendants to another namespace.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing nodes at the target. [default: False]

commands.name: recycle
commands.description: Force a fresh hub initialisation by disposing the current one.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path of the node (or NodeType) to recycle.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile a NodeType and wait for the result.

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.description: Show compile diagnostics for a NodeType.

commands.name: execute-script
commands.description: Run an executable Code node through the kernel.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds. [default: 120]

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload a file into a node's content collection.

commands.name: mirror
commands.description: Mirror a subtree push/pull between two portals.

options.name: --remote-token
options.description: API token issued on the remote portal.

options.name: --target
options.description: Override the target path.

options.name: --remove-missing
options.description: Delete nodes that don't exist on the source side (DESTRUCTIVE). [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Enumerate without writing. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOURCE_PATH
arguments.description: Subtree path on the originating side.

commands.name: navigate-to
commands.description: Print the browser URL for a mesh path.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Mesh path to build a browser URL for.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Log on: store an API token in <path>

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Portal base URL to persist alongside the token.

arguments.name: TOKEN
arguments.description: API token (mw_…). Omit to be prompted interactively.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build and test artefacts inside a MeshWeaver image.

commands.name: plugin
commands.description: Build a plugin: bake its packages, then test the BAKED bytes.

options.name: --image
options.description: Image to build against, e.g. meshweaver.azurecr.io/mw-plugin-test:<tag>. Pulled and pinned by digest.

options.name: --bake-output
options.description: Directory for the bake (bundles + framework-mvid.txt). Default: a temp dir.

options.name: --external-modules
options.description: Directory of external module DLLs to mount at /ext.

options.name: --source-sha
options.description: Commit stamped into the bake, so a bundle records the source it came from.

options.name: --allow
options.description: Allow-file relative to the plugin path (default: plugin-gate.allow, used only if present).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the plugin repo (the directory mounted as /repo).
